thread:
cara: Heads-up: I'm starting a targeted cleanup of the seedbank 'gray zone' near-duplicates before we flip the q6b canary. Found a cluster that slips past fuzzyhash=0.9 but still causes eval noise.
ben: is this impacting goldset stability or label throughput?
alice: saw a bump in disagreement rates on the canary eval yesterday; could be related. can you paste an example query?
cara: yup. quick repro: fuzzy_score between 0.85-0.9 + tokenizer span overlap > 0.7.
```
-- repro
SELECT id, fuzzy_score, span_overlap, source_domain FROM seedbank
WHERE fuzzy_score BETWEEN 0.85 AND 0.9
  AND span_overlap > 0.7
ORDER BY fuzzy_score DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
ben: our dedupe rule is currently `fuzzy_score >= 0.9` — these are in the ambiguous range.
dan: these look like paraphrase/template mixes (same intent, different formatting). Options: raise fuzzy threshold (risky) or add a cheap secondary heuristic (shingles/jaccard or token overlap).
evie: embedding distance is best signal but costs more. shingle_jaccard or 3-gram overlap is a good compromise.
cara: suggested plan: 1) run sweep to surface gray-zone pairs, 2) auto-assign to label-bot for triage, 3) create a 200-pair micro-golden for manual adjudication, 4) add `shingle_jaccard > 0.65` as a tie-break in dedupe, 5) only flip default after micro-golden pass.
alice: I can run micro-golden review with marta as second reviewer. timeline?
cara: sweep today, micro-golden by EOD, canary scheduled next Tue after q6b longctx checks.
ben: make sure sampler prioritizes these pairs (high priority weight) so labelers see them. otherwise they'll be low-traffic.
dan: I'll update sampler config now. draft rule: `priority_rules: - condition: fuzzy_score >= 0.85 AND fuzzy_score < 0.9 -> weight: 12`
evie: also add safeguard: if doc_id differs but same source_domain, mark as "REVIEW" not auto-drop, to avoid deleting distinct records from same publisher.
cara: agree. alice, can you own micro-golden adjudication? ben/dan, land sampler + tie-breaker by EOD? I'll run the sweep and queue label-bot.
alice: yes, pairing with marta.
ben: opening PR and will @cara @alice.
dan: pushed sampler change to staging. I added a small monitoring alert for label backlog: `label-queue-depth > 400` to avoid overload.
label-bot: automated: created job `seedbank-grayzone-1755123456` with 980 pairs. reviewers: alice, marta, evie.
evie: added `jaccard_shingles(text, k=4)` to infra.dedupe utils; perf hit ~4% for full batch but acceptable once-off.
cara: perf ok. we'll decide after micro-golden whether to keep shingle tie-break forever.
alice: micro-golden MG-1755 created. will flag major splits here.
ben: small extra: export token_length_diff and estimated kvcache_footprint for each pair so we can inspect quantization risk.
dan: added fields in sweep export: `token_len_a`, `token_len_b`, `token_len_diff`, `kvcache_est`.
evie: some flagged pairs are short templates with different placeholders — might need a template-normalize step rather than strict dedupe.
cara: good point. keep flags for adjudication; after review we can craft a lighter merge rule for templated examples.
label-bot: update: 260 pairs completed, 18 flagged AMBIGUOUS, 3 conflicts escalated for adjudication.
alice: adjudicating now; will surface borderline cases and propose rule tweaks.
ben: reminder to add a note in the q6b canary runbook that dedupe heuristics changed — runtime teams and SRE should expect small eval metric shifts.
cara: adding runbook blurb now. if micro-golden passes, I'll schedule the canary and include dedupe changes in the canary config. :thumbsup:
label-bot: final update: sweep complete (980 pairs), micro-golden subset 200 ready; results: 172 clear DUP, 18 CONFIRM_SEPARATE, 10 AMBIGUOUS -> adjudication queue created.
adav: (typo correction) DAN meant to say "kvcache footprint" not kvcache_footprint_est, fixed export field.
evie: thanks. after adjudication let's run a small eval comparison (pre/post dedupe) on the q6b devset to quantify metric drift.
cara: agreed. plan: adjudicate this week, run pre/post eval next Fri, canary next Tue if delta < threshold. thanks all.
